# Anne Shirley & Stella Maynard

The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming a close group of ambitious friends and continuing her friendly academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She frequently visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused on her studies. As examinations approach in the spring, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her philosophical mindset with her classmates while they anxiously prepare for tests and discuss commencement attire.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s
